proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E153 (Carbon Black)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E153 (carbon black / vegetable carbon) as Mushbooh (doubtful): it is charred material of animal or vegetable origin (bone char vs wood/plant), so the source must be verified to determine halal status.

researcherNote: E153/unspecified seeded zabiha grade 4 (widely avoided). SANHA classifies E153 mushbooh (may be bone char); the strict follower avoids unverified bone-source carbon. One tier-1 source (non-high-traffic, non-lenient → one clearing citation suffices). APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
